agent_identifier_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the replication agent each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

authorizable_identifier_utf8_ascending_u.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the authorizable each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

entry_identifier_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the replication queue entry each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

entry_path_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the mapping entry address each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

instance_identifier_utf8_ascending_uniqu.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the workflow instance each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

job_identifier_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the Sling job each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

model_identifier_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the workflow model each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

name_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the name each carries, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

persistent_identifier_utf8_ascending_uni.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the configuration each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

preserve.description: The array is a sequence. Its order is part of what it means, so nothing sorts it and nothing refuses a repeat.

queue_name_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the queue each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

relative_repository_path_utf8_ascending_.description: The array is a set of relative property paths, strictly ascending by their UTF-8 bytes.

repository_path_utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of objects, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of each object's repository_path member.

symbolic_name_then_version_utf8_ascendin.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by symbolic name and then by version, because one deployment can hold two versions of one bundle, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

utf8_ascending_unique.description: The array is a set of strings, strictly ascending by their UTF-8 bytes. A repeat is a fault and a permutation is a second spelling of one set.

work_item_identifier_utf8_ascending_uniq.description: The array is a set of objects ordered by the work item each names, strictly ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of that member.

rules.array_order: Arrays retain the order they were written in unless the inventory names a comparator for their pointer.
rules.escapes: Only the quote, the reverse solidus, and control scalars are escaped; a control uses lowercase \u00xx. Every other scalar is emitted directly.
rules.integers: Minimal signed base ten, with no plus sign, no leading zero, and no negative zero.
rules.literals: Boolean and null literals are lowercase.
rules.member_order: The members of an object ascend strictly by their UTF-8 bytes, so no member is named twice.
rules.separators: A comma and a colon carry no surrounding whitespace.
rules.value_count: Exactly one value, with no leading or trailing whitespace.
